topic: The Big Bang in TV static
script: Some of the static on old TVs came from the Big Bang. It is a faint glow called the cosmic microwave background. It is light released about 380,000 years after the universe began. Today it fills all of space, coming from every direction. Two engineers discovered it by accident in 1965. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
